techniques.name: Additive synthesis
techniques.description: Builds timbre by combining and shaping sinusoidal partials.

techniques.name: Automation control
techniques.description: Generates or maps control signals for parameter movement.

techniques.name: Bit and sample-rate reduction
techniques.description: Reduces digital resolution or skips samples for deliberate lo-fi texture.

techniques.name: Chorus
techniques.description: Layers modulated, detuned copies to add width or density.

techniques.name: Clipping
techniques.description: Constrains peaks with a nonlinear transfer curve.

techniques.name: Compression
techniques.description: Reduces dynamic range according to level and timing controls.

techniques.name: Convolution
techniques.description: Applies an impulse response for spaces, filtering, or other captured responses.

techniques.name: DC removal
techniques.description: Removes constant waveform offset around zero.

techniques.name: Delay
techniques.description: Creates time-offset repeats, echoes, or feedback structures.

techniques.name: Distortion
techniques.description: Adds nonlinear saturation, overdrive, or waveshaping.

techniques.name: Equalization
techniques.description: Changes level across selected frequency regions.

techniques.name: Filtering
techniques.description: Attenuates or emphasizes frequency regions with filter responses.

techniques.name: Flanging
techniques.description: Uses short modulated delay and feedback for comb-filter movement.

techniques.name: FM and RM synthesis
techniques.description: Uses frequency or ring modulation to create complex spectra.

techniques.name: Frequency shifting
techniques.description: Moves spectral components by a fixed frequency offset.

techniques.name: Granular synthesis
techniques.description: Reconstructs and transforms audio from short overlapping grains.

techniques.name: Plug-in hosting
techniques.description: Hosts or chains other instruments, effects, or control modules.

techniques.name: Limiting
techniques.description: Restrains peaks above a ceiling or threshold.

techniques.name: Metering and analysis
techniques.description: Displays signal level, spectrum, tuning, or other measurements.

techniques.name: MIDI control
techniques.description: Sends, receives, or transforms MIDI control and note information.

techniques.name: Multiband processing
techniques.description: Splits a signal into frequency bands for independent processing.

techniques.name: Phasing
techniques.description: Uses phase-shifted paths to create moving cancellations and peaks.

techniques.name: Physical modeling
techniques.description: Synthesizes sound from mathematical models of resonating instruments or percussion.

techniques.name: Pitch processing
techniques.description: Detects, corrects, shifts, or harmonizes pitch and sometimes formants.

techniques.name: Resynthesis
techniques.description: Analyzes source audio and reconstructs it with a synthesis model.

techniques.name: Reverb
techniques.description: Creates or reproduces reflections and decay associated with acoustic space.

techniques.name: Signal routing
techniques.description: Directs audio or control signals between processing paths.

techniques.name: Sampling
techniques.description: Maps recorded audio for pitched, one-shot, or multisampled playback.

techniques.name: Sequencing
techniques.description: Generates or transforms ordered musical events.

techniques.name: Sample slicing
techniques.description: Divides audio into regions for rearranged or triggered playback.

techniques.name: Spectral processing
techniques.description: Analyzes or changes sound in the frequency domain.

techniques.name: Stereo imaging
techniques.description: Changes stereo width, balance, phase relationship, or mid-side content.

techniques.name: Subtractive synthesis
techniques.description: Filters harmonically rich oscillators to shape timbre.

techniques.name: Time manipulation
techniques.description: Stretches, gates, repeats, warps, or retriggers time-domain material.

techniques.name: Transient shaping
techniques.description: Changes attack and sustain independently of conventional threshold compression.

techniques.name: Visualization
techniques.description: Turns signal or project information into visual displays.

techniques.name: Vocoding
techniques.description: Imposes a modulator spectrum or envelope onto a carrier signal.
